# Optical-size font fixture

RobotoFlex.ttf is the unmodified Roboto Flex font from Google Fonts, retrieved
2026-09-09 from:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/robotoflex

Upstream filename:
RobotoFlex[GRAD,XOPQ,XTRA,YOPQ,YTAS,YTDE,YTFI,YTLC,YTUC,opsz,slnt,wdth,wght].ttf

Git blob ID: 2a11e4cd5588a89e0047140b09c912059d1a150f
SHA-256: 9b523f7d82593df0107173849ebb8c817471a1df4b4fb2c3cbf40cfd810c8281
Size: 1,787,292 bytes.

Copyright 2017 The Roboto Flex Project Authors.
Licensed under SIL Open Font License 1.1; see RobotoFlex-OFL.txt, retained verbatim.
The font is used only as a browser-test fixture; it is not installed into macOS.
The npm package's files list excludes this test directory.

The opsz axis is Optical Size, minimum 8, default 14, maximum 144. Tests inspect
the actual metadata and render the font to measure glyph changes, rather than
asserting CSS keywords alone. No network access is required to read this fixture.
